$comment: Machine-readable index of the repository, maintained by hand. scripts/validate-workflows.py checks it against the workflow folders, scripts/generate-workflow-readmes.py renders the per-workflow READMEs from it, and scripts/export-workflows.py uses n8n_workflow_id to pull each workflow from the instance it was built on.

n8n.credential_strategy: Most systems run on n8n AI Gateway managed credentials, so Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic and Firecrawl need no user API keys. See docs/CONNECTIONS.md.

workflows.name: Intelligent Model Router
workflows.summary: Deterministic LLM routing across Gemini, OpenAI and Anthropic with privacy and capability gates, cross-vendor fallback and measured latency telemetry.

workflows.name: AI Output Verification Layer
workflows.summary: Deterministic-first verification: JSON Schema, required fields, arithmetic business rules, citation existence and safety markers, then optional claim-level entailment.

workflows.name: Agent Governance and HITL
workflows.summary: Deterministic LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL risk classification, policy validation, Telegram approval and deny-by-default for CRITICAL operations.
external_services: Telegram (human approval channel, optional for testing)
workflows.credential_note: The classification engine and all four risk tiers are testable with no credentials via simulate_decision. Only the real human-approval leg needs a Telegram bot and chat id.

workflows.name: GitOps Prompt Management
workflows.summary: Fetches versioned prompts from GitHub at run time, validates declared variables, interpolates, and returns the blob SHA so every model call is traceable to exact prompt bytes.

workflows.name: Autonomous API Integration Engineer
workflows.summary: Parses an OpenAPI specification deterministically, plans an integration, grounds every step against the real operation list, verifies the plan, gates write steps through Governance and safely probes read-only endpoints.
external_services: Any HTTP API described by an OpenAPI 3 document

workflows.name: Production RAG Intelligence Platform
workflows.summary: Ingestion to grounded answer: chunking with metadata, embeddings, vector storage, metadata-filtered retrieval, deterministic hybrid reranking, citation-bound generation, verification and an explicit no-answer path.
workflows.credential_note: Runs credential-free on the in-memory Simple Vector Store. Qdrant is the documented production swap and needs QDRANT_URL and QDRANT_API_KEY.

workflows.name: Autonomous Research Agent
workflows.summary: Plans a question into sub-questions, searches the live web, deduplicates evidence by URL and content shingles, synthesises a cited report, and verifies every claim against the retrieved sources.

workflows.name: Financial Document Intelligence Agent
workflows.summary: Invoice extraction with arithmetic reconciliation, duplicate fingerprinting against a ledger, an explicit exception taxonomy, verification and escalation to Governance.

workflows.name: Conversational Analytics Agent
workflows.summary: Natural-language analytics where the model never writes SQL: it emits a query spec validated against a metric and dimension registry, which a deterministic compiler turns into a parameterised read-only query.
workflows.credential_note: Ships with a synthetic demo warehouse in an n8n Data Table and needs no database credentials.

workflows.name: Real-Time Voice Automation Agent
workflows.summary: Webhook to speech: transcription, intent classification against a closed tool registry, Governance for data-changing intents, verification, and speech synthesis, with per-stage latency measurement.

workflows.name: CRM Sync Service
workflows.summary: Idempotent CRM write seam. Three supported operations, a write ledger checked before the CRM so a replay never duplicates, and a dry-run branch that simulates deterministic ids with no credential at all.
workflows.credential_note: The three HubSpot nodes ship disabled with their configuration intact. Add a HubSpot App Token credential, enable them, and the live write path works; leave them alone and `dry_run=true` keeps the rest of the swarm testable.

workflows.name: Lead Qualification Agent
workflows.summary: Deterministic lead scoring. The model returns labels from a closed value set with a verbatim quote for each; fixed weights turn labels into points, and a quote that is not in the source text costs the lead points instead of supporting it.

workflows.name: Outreach Composer
workflows.summary: Drafts one outreach message, checks it against deterministic copy rules and the collected evidence, verifies it, and only then asks Governance. A send is a HIGH-risk action, so a human approves it by default.
workflows.credential_note: Telegram is the only channel wired to a real credential, and it needs a chat id from the caller. Email and SMS are drafted and approved, then recorded as not configured.

workflows.name: Revenue Swarm Orchestrator
workflows.summary: Inbound lead to decision record. Deduplicates, qualifies, writes contact, deal and the scoring rationale to the CRM, composes governed outreach, and returns one record naming every step taken and every step skipped.
workflows.credential_note: The public webhook is guarded by an `x-swarm-key` header checked against a `SWARM_INGEST_KEY` n8n variable rather than a credential. While that variable is unset, every inbound lead is refused.

workflows.name: Evaluation Harness
workflows.summary: Scores a labelled golden set under the production rubric and a candidate rubric through the real qualification workflow, then applies a deterministic promotion gate: no regression on any tracked metric, and an improvement on at least one.
workflows.credential_note: No credentials of its own. It runs entirely through workflow 12 with supplied signals, so an evaluation makes no model call and costs nothing to re-run.

workflows.name: Failure Handler
workflows.summary: Dead-letter log for the pipeline. Captures any production failure in 11-15 with its trace id, failing node and execution URL, and offers an audited replay that re-submits a lead through 14 with force set and dry_run still defaulting to true.
workflows.credential_note: No credentials. Set it as the error workflow on 11-15 (already done on this instance); n8n fires it for production executions only, never for a manual test run.
